blocks.html: Fourthly, almost all the witnesses who are heard assure that the prisoner, when he arrived at Artigat, greeted by their names all those he met of the acquaintance of Martin Guerre, without otherwise having ever seen or known them; and if they made some difficulty about recognising him, he reminded them of all things past, and said to each one particularly: Do you not remember when we were at such a place, ten, twelve, fifteen or twenty years ago, that we did such and such a thing in the presence of such and such a one, where we held such and such talk? Even to the said de Rols, his pretended wife, he discoursed, as has been shown above, the most private and particular acts that can pass between husband and wife; and at the first meeting said to her, Go and fetch me the white hose, lined with white taffeta, which I left in such a chest when I went away: which was agreed by the said de Rols to be true, and since verified, that the hose were still there.
